# Key US Data This Week Seen Bolstering Case for October Rate Hike

Key economic reports due this week are expected to add further evidence that the US economy is strengthening, bolstering arguments from several Federal Reserve officials that interest rates should be higher.

Expectations for a rate hike as soon as October have climbed, after recent data showed retail sales jumped in August and business activity in September rose at the fastest pace in more than five years.
